title: Reduce a full contact operator to a positive weighted moment matrix
statement: For open compliance C and K>=kI,the accepted bound is B*[C-(C^-1+K)^-1]B>=Q(Q+N/k)^-1Q,with Q=B*CB,N=B*B. It yields sum h_k(a)v(r)v(r)* bounded by the measured upper matrix,where h_k(a)=a^3 beta k a/(pi+beta k a),strictly increasing for k>0.

requires: Dilute noninteracting strictly buried isolated circular disks in the declared linear-elastic model
Measured two-preload tangent matrices with simultaneous entry/nuisance bounds
Supplied full normal-contact operator coercivity K>=kI,full switching/coverage and an all-open service envelope
provides: A completed accepted source-specific acquisition-to-radius reduction
assumptions: Coercivity and isolated-disk geometry remain supplied
Finite disk bending adds a positive a^5term;center-moment equality alone is wrong
Established positive-operator principles and differential compliance are credited
costs: Two preloads times two modes times positive/negative probes:eight vector measurement settings plus displacement/rotation sensing
Contact/material/calibration/model-error acquisition and reversible/no-growth operation are paid;19fm displacement at5MPa is required,not measured
contract.units: Eprime in Pa,k in Pa/m,a and H in meters,r dimensionless;moment matrices normalize by beta*a_scale^3;Mode-I stress intensity in Pa*sqrt(m).
contract.obstruction: A contact-weighted scalar sensitivity is not acquired by assuming rigid closure.

evidence.quote: ## 2. A contact-weighted lower matrix, without rigid closure
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The contact lower bound is operator coercivity,not a scalar mean or one ultrasound reading. Unknown nonlinear background,partial switching,never-switched cracks,finite-body/interaction corrections and local stress-intensity errors are not automatically bounded by small compliance error. No physical measurements,contact coverage,component qualification or practical advantage were acquired. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
